definitions.explanation: The power that someone actually exercises, as opposed to a title or formal position. Used of politics, companies and families.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{実権|じっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}っている→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: The president holds the real power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、{実権|じっけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The shogun was shogun in name only and had no real power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実権|じっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手放|てばな}そう→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧としなかった。
examples.english: Even after retiring, the chairman would not let go of real control of the company.

notes:
⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (actual) + ⟦{権|けん}→〜権：31354_ken⟧ (power). The word implies a contrast with someone who holds the title but not the power.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実権|じっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧: to hold the real power
- {実権|じっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧: to seize control
- {実権|じっけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手放|てばな}す→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧: to give up control
- {実権|じっけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧: a post without real power
